application_adaptation: Raw observed skill scores; ties rounded to 1e-12, then confirmed non-revoked achievement with a non-empty source, then stable ID; hypothetical pair deduplication and trade-offs only; up to three questions; 0.05 model-point stopping threshold. Application policy differs from research benchmark. No calibrated ability or hiring-success claim.

acceleration.scope: Same linear decision EVOI; NumPy multi_dot for more than 128 allowed pairs; original reference on small pools, near ties and stop boundaries; no change to preference model.

tie_break.scope: Confirmed achievement presence only after an equal rounded skill score. FSP ID alone, pending, revoked and absent source do not qualify; no grade or eligibility change.
